title: Large scale analysis of gender bias and sexism in song lyrics

bias_targets.methodology: Applying a fine-tuned BERT classifier to detect sexist passages in four-line batches of song lyrics and analyzing the proportion of sexist songs across time, musical genres, and artist genders.

Using Word Embedding Association Tests (WEAT, SC-WEAT, and SWEAT) on Word2Vec embeddings trained on song lyrics to measure linguistic associations between gendered target words (e.g., male/female names and pronouns) and stereotypical attribute words (e.g., Career vs. Family, Science vs. Arts, Strength vs. Weakness).
